def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    best_node = None
    best_ratio = np.inf
    for candidate in unvisited_nodes:
        dist_current = distance_matrix[current_node, candidate]
        dist_dest = distance_matrix[candidate, destination_node]
        if dist_dest == 0:
            # This would only happen if candidate equals destination (which shouldn't occur)
            continue
        ratio = dist_current / dist_dest
        if ratio < best_ratio:
            best_ratio = ratio
            best_node = candidate
    return best_node

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    best_node = None
    best_cost = np.inf
    for candidate in unvisited_nodes:
        dist = distance_matrix[current_node, candidate]
        others = unvisited_nodes[unvisited_nodes != candidate]
        if len(others) > 0:
            distances_to_others = distance_matrix[candidate, others]
            mean = np.mean(distances_to_others)
            std = np.std(distances_to_others)
            if mean > 0:
                cv = std / mean
            else:
                cv = 0.0
        else:
            cv = 0.0
        cost = dist * (1 + cv)
        if cost < best_cost:
            best_cost = cost
            best_node = candidate
    return best_node

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    best_node = None
    best_cost = np.inf
    for candidate in unvisited_nodes:
        dist = distance_matrix[current_node, candidate]
        # Exclude candidate from the set when computing standard deviation
        others = unvisited_nodes[unvisited_nodes != candidate]
        if len(others) > 0:
            std = np.std(distance_matrix[candidate, others])
        else:
            std = 0.0
        cost = dist + std
        if cost < best_cost:
            best_cost = cost
            best_node = candidate
    return best_node

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    best_node = None
    best_cost = np.inf
    for candidate in unvisited_nodes:
        dist = distance_matrix[current_node, candidate]
        others = unvisited_nodes[unvisited_nodes != candidate]
        if len(others) > 0:
            var = np.var(distance_matrix[candidate, others])
        else:
            var = 0.0
        cost = dist * (1.0 + var)
        if cost < best_cost:
            best_cost = cost
            best_node = candidate
    return best_node
